clue.text: Halcyon coalition of state and church leaders

explanation.surface: A political alliance between crown and clergy is described as peaceful and calm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Halcyon' reads as the adjective meaning calm, but here it is the noun: the halcyon is the legendary bird identified with this one.
explanation.definitionFit: Halcyon is the classical and poetic name for the bird, the brilliant blue fish-catching species of riverbanks.

clue.text: Jack's boat

clue.text: Blue rinse could be dispensed by this

clue.text: Maybe relish haute couture?

high fashion from Paris, clothing made in France

clue.text: English duck circling round sailors without end

clue.text: Wives having a reclusive existence — Moslems, primarily

clue.text: New camera isn't up to Much Ado About Nothing

clue.text: Where grass is featured in banned scene

clue.text: In the 17th century, Mary had this old money

definitions.text: In the 17th century, Mary had this

clue.text: Send watch back

clue.text: United fans at first exploited

clue.text: Nail, if sticking up, catches girl — but it should be here

clue.text: Learner sitting in beginning to enjoy lecture

clue.text: Nanny has to rush back, having spoken about me the wrong way

clue.text: Dilettante has taken a friend to ancient city

clue.text: Northern Ireland grass comes up, but grows shorter
